acceptanceCriteria: Linux CI uses existing Android KMP/Paparazzi task names and runs all shared module host tests, strict analysis, coverage, Android debug assembly and screenshot verification.
macOS CI compiles/tests every shared iOS module, links the Compose framework and builds the Swift host unsigned for iOS Simulator.
iOS production ads remain disabled and no live Firebase/Yandex/signing secret is required by CI.
Failure reports, coverage and Paparazzi diffs are retained as artifacts.
Actions are SHA-pinned and permissions remain least-privilege.
Documentation separates locally verified gates, macOS/CI-only gates and external release configuration.
The specialist does not run Gradle, Xcode, edit application source or edit the ledger.
goal: Correct the pinned GitHub Actions matrix to run real repository task names, complete Android/quality/Paparazzi gates on Linux and all shared iOS Simulator compile/test plus framework and unsigned Xcode host build gates on macOS, without requiring Firebase/Yandex/signing secrets.
